verdict.rationale: Drata's own docs say users can automate compliance workflows with custom triggers and actions. The same docs describe automating evidence collection through integrations, and the API supports creating custom monitoring tests, which implies background checks against controls. However, every one of these is a one-line marketing or endpoint-title mention, with no detail on how the automations are configured, scheduled or run unattended. missing for 10: detailed docs on the workflow trigger/action builder, explicit evidence of scheduled or continuous background execution, AI-agent-driven autonomous automation beyond natural-language interaction, independent or hands-on corroboration.
